reviews.evidence: Uses root-level show_sidetoc and kramdown.toc_levels instead of page front matter show_sidetoc, h_min: 2 and h_max: 5. The sidebar reads page flags and h_min/h_max, so the requested sidebar/range is not configured.
Correct archive front matter, include_collection: posts,demo and include_missdates: true.
Correct cloudtag page, matching permalink/cloudtag_url, show_tags defaults for posts and collection restriction.
Correct indexcategory, date descending and index_items: 5; correctly restricts bottom navigation to page.previous/next.
Correct complete Liquid include and root-relative fileurl without duplicate baseurl handling, with canonical video source. Omits the requested public playback verification.

limits: Single-run manual factual/task review; not human usability, browser playback, provider integration or repeated-run consistency. Local inventory selector fixes were not deployed.
